Commentary.Commentary: It's been one heck of a series. It all started with New Zealand winning the first ODI only for England to come from behind and take the next two. It was an important one for the hosts today and they have come out victorious by chasing a mountain of runs. What this match has done is, it has made the final ODI the decider. Something that we as cricket fans die for. Tune in on 10th March at 1100 Local (2200 GMT previous day) to catch all the action. Until then, goodbye and cheers!

Man of the match, Ross Taylor says this knock will be right up there in the top drawer. Is really happy to have stayed till the end and pull it off for his side. Mentions the partnerships with Williamson and Latham were crucial and credits them as well. Adds the communication between them is phenomenal and that he enjoys batting with them. On the injury, he said he was really struggling to run between the wickets and informs when he just crossed 100, the physio asked him whether he wants to bat or leave the field. Smiles and says he is glad that he decided to bat on. Reckons one can't win a game in the first 10 overs but can surely lose it. Informs it's his birthday tomorrow and he wanted to win to enjoy it.

Victorious New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson also calls it a great game of cricket. Is delighted with the win and that his side thrived under pressure pleases him all the more. Gives a lot of credit to his bowlers with the way they bowled in the second half. Is short of words to describe Ross Taylor's innings and calls it one of the best knocks he has witnessed in a run chase. Admits the intensity was dropped a bit at the start of the first innings but is proud of the boys to gain it back. On the surface, he feels it was a great one and didn't change much throughout the course of the game. Wishes Taylor a speedy recovery and hopes that he plays the next game too.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan starts by saying it was a beauty of a game. Smiles and says it was a good match as the crowd was thoroughly entertained. Adds there was a bit of moisture at the toss and he would have done exactly what Williamson did. States they were very much in the game as their openers set it up beautifully but the collapse towards the end has hurt them big time. Tells us that they bat deep and usually they go hard in that situation, today they just couldn't manage to do it. Credits the hosts' bowlers for pulling things back. Praises Ross Taylor for his outstanding knock which took the game away from them.

Also not to forget the comeback the Kiwis made with the ball towards the end of the first innings. It was that effort which kept them in the game. At one stage when Root and Bairstow were going great guns, 400 looked possible but an inspirational bowling performance by Sodhi saw them getting bundled out for a total which the home side, in the end, chased down quite comfortably. Stay tuned for the presentation in a while.

Colin de Grandhomme came in after that and played his shots but there was some drama towards the end as Chris Woakes and Tom Curran bowled a few tight overs and also picked the wicket of Colin de Grandhomme. But Ross Taylor stayed there till the end and ensured he took his team over the finish line.

It all started with New Zealand losing both their openers for a duck with Chris Woakes picking one and Mark Wood taking one. They looked down and out at 2-2. But then Kane Williamson and Ross Taylor joined forces and counter-attacked. They stitched a 84-run stand which did give them a little momentum. However, when Kane Williamson was adjudged out caught behind of Ben Stokes, it seemed like the Kiwis would once again go onto the back foot. That was not the case though. Ross Taylor continued milking the bowlers and Tom Latham joined the party after that. The southpaw did ride his luck as he was dropped once and he survived a few close calls but the two stitched a match defining 187-run stand, giving the spinners and the pacers a pounding in the course before the left-hander departed.

PHEW! What a game, take a bow Ross Taylor. He walks off to a standing ovation by the crowd, by his teammates and he deserves every bit of it. What a run chase and how well did he construct it. The hosts continue their domination on this ground and this victory will surely be one of their best.

SIX! BANG! The drama does not last for long as Nicholls finishes it in style! The series is ON! It is 2-2. A full ball on leg stump, Nicholls flicks it over the square leg fence for a biggie. A cool and calm celebration by Henry. He gives Ross Taylor a high-five as NEW ZEALAND WIN BY 5 WICKETS!
Drama, drama right at the end. Another dot. 3 now from 4. A full ball on off, Nicholls smashes it to mid off.

It is all happening out there, an LBW appeal, a run out missed and what not. A fuller ball around leg stump. Nicholls goes for the slog but misses to get hit on the pads. The bowler starts appealing as the batsman sets off for a run. He though is sent back by his partner as the point fielder is quick to the ball. Nicholls slips as he turns but the fielder misses his shy and Henry makes it back. A dot but, 3 needed off 5.
Just 3 needed off the final over. Tom Curran will be the one bowling it. Can he pull this off?
Very full on middle worked through mid-wicket for a run.
A yorker on off, hit towards mid off for a run.
A short ball outside off, Taylor tries to pull but gets beaten.
Slower ball outside off, eased through covers for a run.
Full and outside off, drilled through covers for a run. He is holding his arm now after hitting that shot, might have gotten a jerk there.
SIX! There she goes! A full toss, Taylor who is seeing the ball like a football out there deposits it in the stands at mid-wicket.
A yorker outside off, jammed out to covers. 13 from 12.
Smart batting! He has been doing this all day. Good length on off, guided down to third man for a run.

Not watching the ball is Henry! Short and a slower one. Nicholls is completely foxed as he is early into the pull. He anyhow manages to get a bottom edge and down to third man for a run. 14 from 14 now.
A slower ball and on a shorter length. Nicholls tries to pull but gets a bottom edge back to the bowler.
Smart batting! Watchfully flicks it through square leg and runs a single.
Slower ball on leg stump, tucked around the corner for a run. Singles is all they need, no need of anything fancy.
FOUR! Through extra covers! That should probably seal the game. A very full ball outside off, Taylor smashes it through covers for a boundary. 15 runs from the other and NZ need 17 from 18 balls now.

Brilliant effort by the fielder in the deep! A full ball outside off, Taylor carves it away on the off side. He runs one and somehow manages to go for the second and completes it in the end. The crowd is on its feet here for this man, what an effort from him!

SIX! BOOM! A rare bad ball by Woakes and that has cost him. Right in the slot, full and on off. Taylor sends it over the long on fence for a much-needed biggie. 23 in 20 now. Just a difference of 3 between balls and runs.
A very full ball on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a run.

Excellent bowling! Woakes knows Taylor is looking to go on side so he fires it full outside off wanting Taylor to go for a wild slog. Taylor however, plays the ball on its merit and strokes it through point but only for a run as he can't go for the second.
Fuller on off, driven through covers for a run.

A dot to finish! Just 2 from this, 5 from the last 2 overs. A yorker on middle, Taylor gets an inside edge onto his boots. The players make a huge appeal, an ambitious one but the umpire shakes his head. Ross is down in agony and he needs to be treated again. 32 in 24, they need exactly 8 per over. The margin between ball and runs increasing now.
Fuller on off, driven through covers for a run.
Henry Nicholls strides out to the middle.

OUT! De Grandhomme has carved it straight to Chris Woakes! A timely wicket for England. This game is still on, folks. A good last over and now only 1 run and a wicket off the first four balls in this. Curran doles out a low full toss outside off, Colin smashes it straight to backward point where Woakes takes a sharp catch. They go upstairs to check the front foot but it is fine. A good cameo by Colin comes to an end but at the wrong time. England trying to fight their way back. 33  needed in 26 balls.
Another dot! 1 from the first three! A low full toss again. De Grandhomme this time can't take toll of it and he drives it to covers.
Fuller on middle, worked down to long on for a run.
A full toss, Taylor drives it to mid off and he can't run. Dot to begin with.
A dot to finish! Just three from the over. England need two or three overs more like this. Short and wide outside off, Colin tries to cut it with all his force but misses. 34 now from 30.
Taylor hits it in the gap but can only run one! A short ball on middle, Taylor pulls it through square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, dives and only concedes one.
Full outside off, drilled to mid off.
Very good bowling here! Very full outside off, can't do a lot with that delivery as de Grandhomme jams it out towards point for a run.
A full toss on middle, eased down to long on and Taylor limps to the other end. 300 up for New Zealand only 36 needed now.
Full and wide outside off, Taylor swings his bat but only connects with thin air.
Chris Woakes is back on.
Excellent delivery! A yorker on middle, Colin digs it out. A dot to finish but the damage has been done in this over. 14 from it.
Back of a length outside off, guided down to third man for a run.
Shorter in length on off, pulled through square leg for a run. 13 runs from the over so far.
SIX! Effortless! Slower ball on middle, Colin nonchalantly flicks it over the square leg fence for a biggie. 39 in 39 is the equation. Run-a-ball is what it has all come down to now.
Slower ball on off, Colin tries to work it on the on side for a run but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

SIX! Colin de Grandhomme means business here! He is on fire since the time he has come out. Short and on middle, uses the pace of the bowler as he ramps it over the keeper and it goes sailing over the third man fence for a maximum.

Tossed up wider outside off, Taylor takes a long stride forward and with those strong bottom hands he drills it through extra cover for a brace. 12 from Rashid's last over and he finishes with figures of 10-0-74-0!
Leans ahead and drives it past the cover region for one.
FOUR! More runs! Tossed up wider outside off, de Grandhomme makes room and lofts it over extra cover to find the fence again.
FOUR! Downtown! Tossed up delivery around middle and off, Colin hits it straight down the ground and picks up a boundary.
Loops it up around off, Ross looks to slog sweep it but gets it off the inner half towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, skidding off the surface, Taylor looks to cut but chops it towards point.
Colin de Grandhomme walks out to bat.

OUT! The 187-run partnership has been broken! Latham is the man who has been dismissed after playing an excellent knock. But after already getting a boundary in this over, was this shot needed? England won't mind though as Curran bowls a slower ball on off which completely deceives Latham. He tries to go big but slices it towards Moeen Ali at covers who stations himself under it and takes it. A ray of hope here for England, 63 needed off 48 balls.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.

FOUR! 150 up Ross Taylor, what an innings it has been from this man. Even though he is struggling with an injury, he is just milking the runs. A true champion. He squeezes this full ball outside off through point. The fielder in the deep does get a hand to it but can't stop it.
Angles it into the batsman, eased down to long on for a run. Just three form the first three.
This is exactly where England faltered. 267 was the score when they lost Bairstow and it led to a collapse. Is that going to hurt them? We shall wait and find out...
Slower short ball on middle, pulled through square leg for a run.
Fuller on middle, Taylor goes for the paddle but hits it straight to short fine leg.
Tom Curran is back on.
Nails the reverse sweep but straight to short third man. 70 needed in 54.
Mistimes his heave through mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! Why run singles when you can tonk them out of the ground? Rashid tosses it up on middle, Taylor lines behind it and dispatches it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Makes use of his feet again and flicks it in the gap between deep mid-wicket and long on but only gets one as Taylor is struggling.
Eases it down the ground to long on for an easy run.
Uses his feet and works it down to long on for a run.
Adil Rashid is back on.
A single to end the over, 15 off it. Shorter on middle, worked around the corner for a run.
Drills this through covers but only for a run.
FOUR! Make that three in row! 82 more needed! Taylor wants to end it early. Short and wide outside off, he loves cutting it and does exactly that as he slaps it through point for a boundary.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over! Once again it is a lucky one! Full and wide outside off. Taylor throws the kitchen sink at it and gets an outside edge past the diving keeper for another boundary.
WIDE! Outside off, Taylor leaves it and the umpire calls it a wide.
FOUR! Up and over! Short ball outside off, Taylor cuts it high up in the air. It goes over point but away from the third man fielder for a boundary.
Good bowling by Wood. Bowls it wide outside off, wanting Taylor to go over the off side. The batsman does try but does not connect.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The fielder goes for a direct hit but misses the stumps. One run added to the total. 95 more needed now. New Zealand in control.
EDGY FOUR! Taylor won't mind though! On a length around off, Taylor looks to heave it on the leg side but the ball takes the top edge and goes over the vacant slip cordon for a boundary.
WIDE! The pressure is getting to Stokes here. A slower ball which is way down the leg side, it must have slipped out of his hands and the umpire signals a wide.
SIX! BOOM! That has gone a long way! Stokes bowls it just where Taylor likes it, full on middle. Taylor sends it sailing over the mid-wicket fence for half a dozen.
Gets under the ball and drives it down towards mid on. Latham comes down the track in search of a single but Taylor sends him back.
Uppish but safe! Short ball and a lot of room on offer, Tom looks to cut it hard but does so aerially past backward point for a single.
Stokes angles it into the pads, Taylor is happy to milk a single by clipping it through mid-wicket.
Ross Taylor once again calls for the physio and is strapping up his thigh area.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary! Fuller ball on the pads, Latham just chips it nonchalantly over mid on. Root gives it a chase, slides and tries to pull the ball back in play but fails to do so. A boundary results! 109 needed from 72 balls now.
Back of a length outside off, steered straight to the point fielder.
Angling in on middle, another mistimed pulled by Taylor towards mid-wicket for a single. He is really struggling out there, isn't able to run.
Dishes out a low full toss on the pads, whipped away past the man at mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish outside off, TL hops back and defends it back down the pitch.
Attacks the stumps does Mark, Ross looks to swipe it across the line but mistimes it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, pushed towards cover. 116 needed off 78 balls.
Hops and with an angled blade Taylor guides it down to third man. He looks uncomfortable as soon as he started to run.
Ross Taylor after the dive seems to have pulled his quad muscle. He is getting a bit of treatment. His side would hope that he's fine.

Misfield! England are feeling the pressure now! Taylor cuts it fiercely towards backward point where Roy lets it through. They want another one and the throw from the deep is a good one as Taylor has to dive to get back in.
Latham punches it towards cover and calls through for a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but no harm done.
SIX! Pummeled! New Zealand have started to fire now! It's a length delivery, angling in towards middle, Tom walks across and short-arm pulls it over deep square leg. Boom!
Shortish outside off, dabbed towards short third man for a single.
Double change as Ben Stokes comes on to bowl.

SIX! What a hit! Fifty comes up for Latham with the meaty blow. Wood comes from around the wicket and angles it in on middle and leg, Tom stays back and just drops kicks it over deep square leg for a maximum all the way. 14 coming from that over, a good one for the hosts.
Looks to cut again but gets it off the edge down to third man for a single.

Shortish on middle and leg, Tom Latham inside edges it on the pads as the ball rolls beside the pitch. Taylor calls him through for a single. Wood charges towards the ball and tries to kick it onto the stumps but misses.
Another one on a similar length, it's cut away fine down to third man where Rashid cuts it off. A single taken.
FOUR! Flayed! Short and a tinge of width on offer. Enough for Taylor to slap it over the backward point fielder for a boundary. 200 up for the Kiwis.
Back of a length delivery outside off, a nice punch through cover for a single.
Mark Wood is brought back into the attack. He has given 29 runs and has picked up a wicket in the 5 overs that he has bowled so far.
Flatter again outside off, Ross wants to cut but ends up chopping it once again towards point.
Comes down the track but ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
Flatter and closer to off stump, Ross chops it towards point.
19th ODI ton for the experienced campaigner! Well played, Rosco! Goes back and cuts it behind point for a double to bring up the milestone. Can he take his side home?
Floats it up on the stumps, Ross drives it back to the bowler.
Very full around leg, Latham digs it out towards mid-wicket. Rashid himself runs after the ball as the batsmen take a run.
Drinks are on the field.

FOUR! Glorious! Takes Taylor to 98 now. Ali fires it full around middle and off, Ross makes a bit of room and creams it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary to end the over. 10 from it, NZ need 144 more to win.
Gets down and sweeps it towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Another single taken.
Fired on leg, whipped to deep square leg for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quicker one on the stumps, RT looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.

FOUR! Drilled it! That brings up the century stand between Taylor and Latham. These two have kept NZ in the hunt. Tossed up ball outside off, Ross bashes it through cover for a boundary to start the over.
Cuts it behind point for a single.

FOUR! Good effort from Bairstow again! Nearly pulled off a stunner. Adil bowls a short ball on the stumps, Ross goes back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Jonny moves across to his right, sticks his right hand out and nearly plucks it but the ball doesn't stick. Instead it trickles away to the fence.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.

Stumping chance missed! Buttler was busy appealing for the LBW! Tom dances down the track, a long way down the track in fact to flick but misses. It goes off the pads as Jos ducks under it and keeps appealing for an LBW. The umpire turns it down and a leg bye is also signaled. Replays show it would have gone on to hit the stumps.
Flatter one around leg, clipped towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls a googly, Taylor takes a stride forward and pushes it back to Rashid.

Good running! Tom flicks it with soft hands towards mid-wicket and calls for two. Jonny from the deep charges towards the ball, picks it up and fires it at the non-striker's end but misses. The stand moves to 89 now.
Drills a tossed up ball through cover for a single.
Uses his feet to a flatter delivery and wrists it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted ball around middle, Tom sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket where it is stopped inside the boundary line with a dive. Two more taken.
Clips it behind square leg and gets one. This ball stayed a bit low as well.
Tossed up ball outside off, worked with the spin towards square leg.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Tom wrists it through backward square leg and gets two for doing so.
Rashid drops it short, Ross rocks back immediately and pulls it powerfully towards deep mid-wicket where Bairstow comes running to his right and dives to keep them down to one. Exceptional!
Quicker ball around off, Taylor presses forward and defends.
Uses his feet to a tossed up ball and clips it towards mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up outside off, Ross drives it towards cover where the fielder half stops it. A single taken.
Short and quicker through the air, chopped to point.
Taps it off the back foot towards backward square leg to keep strike.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Too full and straight, Latham looks to play the reverse sweep but doesn't connect.
Worked with the spin through square leg for a single.

Huge shout for an LBW! Ali keeps it full on the stumps, Tom comes down the track to flick but misses and wears it on the pads as the ball rolls towards point. The batsmen cross for a leg bye but Moeen is busy appealing. The umpire, however shakes his head. Replays show it's pitched in line and would have gone on to hit the stumps. So, it wasn't a bad appeal!
FOUR! So, so close! Ali fires it full on the stumps, Latham once again wants to play the sweep but gets a bottom edge through his legs and past the stumps towards fine leg for a streaky boundary.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated delivery outside off, Tom nails the reverse sweep towards deep square leg where Root dives to keep them down to two.
Quicker and flatter again, this time around middle and leg. Clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker and shorter in length outside off, Taylor punches it square on the off side and gets a brace. 150 comes up for his side!
This time he gets down and plays the conventional sweep towards deep square leg for a single.
Quicker and flatter through the air, reverse swept through cover-point for a brace.
Jumps down the track and eases it down to long on for a single. 13 off the over and NZ need another 190 to win.
Goes back and tucks it through square leg for one.

SIX! Flies over! Tossed up around off, spinning back in, Taylor gets down to sweep but gets it off the top edge. Doesn't matter as he had enough meat to send it sailing over the backward square leg fence for half a dozen.

FOUR! Clever play from Ross! Ali goes fuller outside off, Taylor gets into the position early and reverse sweeps it fine down towards third man for a boundary to bring up the 50-run stand between the two. Replays show it had come off the back of the bat.
Fires it on off, Taylor drives it towards mid on.
Flatter one on the stumps, TL looks to play the reverse sweep but gets it off the back of the bat to short fine leg for a single.
Tom skips down the track and nearly yorks himself. Jams it out over the bowler and will get a single.
Latham tries to play the reverse sweep but misses as this leg break turns towards leg and he gets rapped on the pads.
Rashid gives it some more flight, lands it full outside off, Taylor smashes it down to long off for just a single.
Loopy leg break around middle and leg, tucked through mid-wicket and scampers through for a double.
Bowls a googly, it skids off the deck, Taylor waits for it and nearly is done in by it. Luckily for him he manages to keep it out.
Tossed up delivery from over the wicket, Latham gets down to sweep but gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg.
Adil Rashid is brought back into the attack.
Adil Rashid is back on.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.
Tosses it up on off, driven back towards the bowler who dives to his right and fields the ball. He bumps into the batsman who falls onto the ground.
Tosses it up outside off, Taylor defends it.
Comes down the track and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Eases it down the ground for a run.
Sweeps it all along the ground for a run.
Due to the extra man brought in the cover region. Latham shuffles across and tries to flick but the ball takes the outside edge due to the angle. it goes down to third man for a run.
A good shot but not a boundary! Short and outside off, Latham reaches out for it and slaps it through covers. The player in the deep runs to his left, dives and keeps it down to two.
Shortish on off, pulled towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a length around off, pushed through covers for a run.
Slower ball on off, Taylor checks his shot back towards the bowler. Stokes gets a hand to it and deflects it towards cover and the batsmen take a run.
Good length on off, kept out solidly. Just one from the last 7 balls.
Just a single from this over! Tosses it up on off, worked through square leg for a run. A few tight overs here by England, the rate is going up, New Zealand need a move on here.
Five dots in a row! Pressure building! Loopy ball on off, driven to covers.
Four dots in a row! Fuller on middle, Taylor flicks it to mid-wicket.
Worked with the spin to mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, turning back in. Taylor misses the flick to get hit on the pads. There is a stifled appeal by the players but the umpire stays put.
Slower through the air on off, defended.
Slower delivery but on the pads, flicked through square leg for a run.
Fuller on off, driven towards mid off for a quick run.
Slower ball on middle, kept out.
On a length around off, pushed to mid off.
A bumper on middle, Taylor tries to pull but it goes off the top edge but well short of the fielder at deep square leg for a run.
Angles it into the batsman who works it towards mid-wicket.
Works it with the turn through square leg for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fires it on the stumps, pushed to covers.
Flatter on off, played to point.
Comes down the track and takes it on the full. Can't find the gap though as he hits it to covers.
Shuffles acorss and works it with the spin down to long on for a run.
Very full outside off, drives it on the bounce to covers. 224 more needed now.
Length outside off, guided down to third man for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Works it around the corner for a run.
On a length around off, guided down to third man for a run.

42nd fifty in ODIs for Taylor. His good form in this series continues. Missed the last game but that didn't affect his form. Flicks this ball towards fine leg for a run and acknowledges the applause of the crowd. Ross knows his job is not done yet and needs to carry on.
SIX! An over which started with a drop catch ends with a maximum! Short ball on middle, Latham rocks back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Floats it up on off, defended.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Very full on off, Taylor drives it through covers for a run.
Flatter on off, pushed through covers for a run.

DROPPED! Moeen almost had Latham again! He tosses it up on middle, Tom tries to play across the line but closes the bat face early, he gets a leading edge back to the bowler who has three attempts at it but can't hang on. Another English bowler could have struck on his first ball. Nevertheless, a reprieve for Latham, he would now look to make the most of it.
Moeen Ali is into the attack.
On a length around off, Latham guides it down to third man for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
On a length around off, it takes off the surface. Taylor defends it.

NOT OUT! Pitched outside leg! England too lose their sole review now. That never looked out to be honest. Stokes bowls it full around leg stump. Latham misses the flick to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Stokes though feels Latham is a goner and he convinces his captain to review it. His captain does so and Hot Spot at first shows a mark on the bat but there is nothing on Ultra Edge. Hawk Eye later on shows the ball is pitching outside leg. The on-field call stays and a leg bye has been added to the total.
Review time! England review now as Stokes feels he has Latham LBW. The umpire does not feel so as the it seems to be pitching outside leg.
Shorter in length on off, Latham tries to tap and run but there is not a run in it.

Excellent stop! Back of a length on off, pushed towards point where the fielder dives to his right and makes a very good stop. He also has a shy at the non striker's end as Taylor had taken a start but misses.
Length ball around off, defended.
Fuller on the pads, flicked through mid on for a run.
Comes around the wicket to the left hander and lands it on a length around off. Defended.
On a length outside off, guided down to third man for a run.
FOUR! That has been hit with authority! Short, this time it came at a good height for the batsman. He rocks back and pulls it with disdain beating the dive of the fielder in the deep for a boundary.
Good bowling! A surprise bouncer on middle, Taylor is surprised by it as he goes for the pull but is beaten by pace.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Back of a length on off, punched through covers for a run.
A short delivery which has been pulled away.
Angles it into the batsman, flicks it through fine leg for a run.
On the pads, worked around the corner for a run.
Tom Latham is the new man in, replacing Williamson.

OUT! Gone! Stokes gets the big wicket and once again an English bowler strikes off his first ball. A similar way to how Root got out earlier today. A short ball down the leg side, Williamson goes for the pull but only manages to glove it to Buttler who accepts it and appeals. The umpire gives it a thought and then raises his finger. Huge breakthrough for England and they have broken the 84-run stand. Williamson walks back in disappointment as he falls 5 short of his fifty. New Zealand's woes deepen as they still need another 250 runs. Wait... hold on, Williamson was not disappointed about his shot, he was disappointed as he had not gloved it as there was no spike on Snicko as it passed the bat. Well, there is nothing he could do as Munro wasted the review very early in the innings. Nevertheless, England won't mind as they have dented the hopes of New Zealand chasing this target down.
Ben Stokes is into the attack.
Hangs back to a short ball and taps it towards backward point. Wants a run but Roy is quick to deny them.
Drops it on a back of a length outside off, punched towards sweeper cover for a single.
Short ball, too close outside off, Taylor goes deep in the crease to cut it down to third man for a single.
Curran bangs in a short one and directs it towards the batsman. Taylor picks it up but is a tad early in pulling it across. Gets beaten.
Now stays back and steers it down to third man to get off strike.
Up and over! On a length outside off, Kane comes down the track and lofts it over a leaping extra cover fielder for a couple.
FOUR! Bread and butter for Taylor! Rashid sends it flatter but the length his short outside off. Ross rocks back and with those quick hands his cut it behind point for a rocketing boundary.
Tossed up on off, driven through cover for a single.

What a stop from Stokes! Drops it short on middle, Williamson rocks back and pulls it towards mid-wicket. Stokes initially was moving to his right but then adjusts and quickly dives to his left and stops it with one hand. Stunning! Saved a certain boundary.
Quicker through the air around middle and leg, Taylor goes back and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it up on off, kept out.
Flatter on middle, whipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Guides it down to third man for a run. 7 from the over, just what they need of each over.
Excellent stop! Fuller on off, Williamson times it through covers. The fielder in the deep runs to his right, dives and keeps it down to two.
Another run! Down the leg side, tucked towards fine leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, pushed through point for a run. Good batting, if the boundaries are not coming, keep the singles ticking over.
On the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Angles it on middle, worked through square leg for a run.
Gives it air on off, Taylor lunges forward and keeps it out.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! Once again uses his feet, he does not get to the pitch of the ball though but still goes on with his shot and lofts it over long on for half a dozen.
Advances down the track and works it around the corner for a run.
Tosses it up on off, driven through covers for a run.
Dances down the track and tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. The keeper appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
Length outside off, guided down to third man for a run.
Almost chops it on! Williamson tries to run down a delivery that was too close to him. The ball takes the inside edge and hits his pads.
Back of a length on off, Taylor shimmies down the track and works it towards point for a run.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket.
On off, worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Welcome Curran! He errs in line and bowls it on the pads, Taylor flicks it through backward square leg and there is no stopping that ball.
Tom Curran is into the attack.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single. 50-run stand up between the two, still a long way to go.
The googly on off, Williamson picks it and pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
A low full toss on the leg side, Taylor sweeps it off the toe end of the bat down to fine leg for a run. 50 up for the Kiwis.
Floats it up on off, kept out.
FOUR! Bad ball! Short again and also offers width. Taylor cashes in on it and cuts it through point and into the fence. The partnership is now 47 between the two.
Short ball but Williamson could not take full toll of it as he pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Spin! Adil Rashid comes into the attack.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Good running! A single to end the Powerplay, a good one for England. Williamson taps it towards the off side and gets to the other end.
Good length on off, defended.
Good batting! Follows the boundaries up with a run. On a length around off, guided down to third man for a run.
FOUR! 10 runs from the last two balls! New Zealand getting a move on here. On the pads, Taylor helps it on its way through fine leg and the ball races away.
SIX! All the way! First of this innings! A short ball, not that short on middle. Taylor walks down the track a little and pulls it over the fine leg fence for a biggie.
Angles it into the batsman. Taylor works it to mid-wicket.
Length ball around off, pushed to covers.
On the pads, Taylor misses the flick and the ball hits the pads and rolls towards square leg. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Shortish outside off, Williamson cuts it hard towards point where Roy misfields and concedes a run.
Back of a length on middle, defended to mid on.

FOUR! What placement! They have 3 men near the point region but he picks the gap to perfection! Length outside off, Williamson waits for it and guides it through cover-point and the ball races away. 306 more needed.
Fullish on middle, driven to mid on.
Another length ball around off, guided down towards third man for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Overthrow! Just ahead of a length on off, Williamson drives it straight to cover where Bairstow has a needless shy at the non-striker's end but misses. There is nobody backing up and the batsmen run two overthrows.
FOUR! Might be a strong off side field but placement was perfect. Short and wide outside off, Williamson cuts it through point and the ball races away.
On a length around middle, whipped to mid on.
Short ball on middle, Taylor pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg for a run.
Length ball on off, Williamson solidly keeps it out.
Shorter in length around off, cut through point for a run.
Fuller on middle, eased to mid on.
On a length on off, defended back to the bowler.
Fullish on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Wonderful! All timing from Taylor. Slightly fuller on off, Taylor leans into it and times it through covers to find the fence.
A dot to finish! Length ball on off, kept out.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the pads, Taylor flicks it down to fine leg for a single.
On off, Taylor tries to force it through the off side but mistimes it to covers.
Good length outside off, guided down to third man to change strike.
FOUR! Top shot! Full and on middle, Williamson drives it straight down the ground where there are no fielders placed and a boundary results.
Fullish ball on middle, eased down to mid on.
Shorter in length on middle, Williamson whips it towards wide mid on for a run.
Streaky runs! On a length around off, Williamson tries to defend it but gets an inside edge which goes close past the leg pole and down towards fine leg for a brace.
Make that 16. On the stumps, Williamson plays it back to the bowler.
Back of a length on off, pushed to covers. 15 dots in a row for Woakes.
Length ball around off, kept out.
On a length outside off, Taylor guides it down to third man for a run.
Taylor is away as he flicks this ball down to fine leg for an easy run. Just a run from this over! 3 from the first 4 overs and also two wickets down. A sorry-looking start when you are chasing 336.
Fullish on off, driven to mid off.
Once again gives no room to the batsman and bowls it tight on the stumps. Taylor guides it to point.
Fuller on the pads, Taylor can't find the gap as he flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length around middle, blocked confidently.
Length ball around off, Taylor defends it solidly.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. Second consecutive maiden for Woakes, this one is a wicket maiden though.
Back of a length on off, guided to covers.
Ross Taylor walks out to the middle.

OUT! In the air... caught! Guptill is the man walking back now. Two wickets in two overs for England and both the Kiwi openers are back in the hut for a duck. All those dot balls have brought about a wicket. Guptill walks down the track and Woakes bangs it a little short. Martin tries to go big but only manages to hit it up in the air towards cover where Ben Stokes runs towards the ball, settles under it and takes it easily. Another big wicket for England and New Zealand are in deep, deep trouble here.
The batsman gets a bottom edge on that one.
Good length on off, kept out.
On a length, angling into the batsman, it also skids off the surface. Guptill tries to flick but misses to get hit near the box.
Shortish on off, punched to covers. End of a successful over. Two really good overs to begin with by England.
Back of a length ball on off, Williamson keeps it out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shorter in length on off, Kane defends it.
Off the mark starightaway! Back of a length on middle, Williamson rocks back and flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Kane Williamson is the next man in.

OUT! No bat involved and Munro bags a golden duck! Wood strikes off his first delivery! That looked very plumb. A poor review by Munro and the Kiwis have lost their sole review early. Simon Doull on air calls it as an 'Incredibly selfish decision from Munro'! True that! A full ball by Wood on middle, it swung back in late. Munro tries to flick but is done in by the late swing and nearly falls over to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Munro after a chat with Guptill opts to review. They go upstairs and Hawk Eye shows three reds. An early wicket for England and it is the dangerous Colin who walks back cheaply, yet again.
Munro is a goner! He has been adjudged LBW but he has reviewed it. Looks plumb only an inside edge could save him.
Mark Wood will bowl with the second new ball.
A maiden to begin with! On a length around off, Guptill defends it towards point.
Hits the length hard on off, Guptill defends it onto the ground.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Confusion but safe! Shorter in length on off, Guptill taps it towards point and sets off for a run. The fielder from point is quick to the ball and seeing that Munro sends him back. Guptill turns and tries to make it back. The fielder has a shy but misses. Had he hit it would have been interesting.
Another delivery on the stumps, Guptill lunges forward and keeps it out.
Starts off with a back of a length delivery on off, Guptill rocks onto the back foot and punches it to covers.

Welcome back for the run chase. Can the Kiwi openers - Colin Munro and Martin Guptill provide their side a flying start? Remains to be seen. Here comes Chris Woakes running in to kickoff the proceedings with the ball. Two slips in place.
